description_en: You can call this operation to query all templates under your account. This way, you can view template details, including the template approval status, template type, and template content
description_zh: 可以通过此接口查询您账号下的所有模板，方便您查看模板详情，包括模板审核状态、模板类型、模板内容等
name: QuerySmsTemplateList

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Default value: **1**
parameters.name: page_index

parameters.help_en: The number of templates displayed per page. Valid values: **1 to 50**. Default value: **10**
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的模板个数。取值范围：**1~50**，默认取值为**10**
parameters.name: page_size
